overview.name: Sindhuli Community Technical Institute
overview.address: Nunthala, Kamalamai Municipality-6, Rammadi, Sindhuli, Bagmati Province, Nepal
overview.description: Nonprofit community technical institute formed with DCC Sindhuli, Kamalamai Municipality, and CTEVT. Operates on CTEVT-owned land of about 3.399 hectares at Nunthala. Runs CTEVT diploma programs and Kathmandu University bachelor programs in technical education. A 2022 KU agreement covered B.Tech.Ed. (IT) and B.Tech.Ed. (Civil Engineering).
overview.mission: To produce skilled technical workforce as per community and industrial needs.
overview.vision: A leading polytechnic that provides qualitative training and education to create skilled manpower, and generates new knowledge for society and industry.
